title: Proof of Making
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: Proof of making is a chain of contemporaneous records that can support authorship, development, contribution, and custody questions without pretending that documentation itself decides ownership.
A documented copy after a Worth model makes the line between reference, attribution, and surviving object evidence visible.

01 · ORIGIN — What is the earliest reliable record?. Preserve native file, physical notebook or sample, creator, date basis, device or system context, identifier, and custody. Distinguish recorded time from an unverified recollection.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · CHANGE — Can development be reconstructed?. Link versions, annotations, patterns, fittings, samples, approvals, and rejected alternatives. Keep contributor corrections and disagreements rather than overwriting them.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · RIGHT — What does the evidence not decide?. Separate factual creation history from U.S. copyright authorship, work-made-for-hire, transfer, contract, patent, design, trademark, foreign-law, and confidentiality questions.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · CUSTODY — Can the chain survive movement?. Record every deposit, handoff, copy, migration, sale, loan, publication, return, and deletion with responsible person and integrity check.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
